def objs(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']>10:
            b=n['boundary']; out.append(('Y',min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),n['pixels']))
        if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']>10:

Plan: Test consecutive drags: piece→cup, ball→slot, ball→cup, piece→slot (8 clicks), checking for movement after each; if nothing happens, spend the remaining budget on the most likely bar states.

def objs(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']>10:
            b=n['boundary']; out.append(('Y',min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),n['pixels']))
        if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']>10:
            b=n['boundary']; out.append(('b',min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),n['pixels']))
    return sorted(out)
base=objs(current_frame)
def check(tag):
    r=last_action_result
    moved=objs(current_frame)!=base
    done=r.get('level_completed') or r.get('game_over') or r.get('done')
    print(tag,"moved:",moved,"done:",done)
    return done or moved
stop=False
drags=[((14,31),(35,31),'piece->cup'),((55,36),(50,36),'ball->slot'),((55,36),(35,31),'ball->cup'),((14,31),(50,36),'piece->slot')]
for a,b,tag in drags:
    if stop: break
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':a[0],'col':a[1]}])
    if check(tag+" start"): stop=True; continue
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':b[0],'col':b[1]}])
    if check(tag+" end"): stop=True
print("stop:",stop)
